name: Compressed Air Leak Plausibility
trigger_conditions: compressed air system plausible or observed
anti_triggers: recent leak survey shows low leakage
physical_basis: Compressed air systems recurrently lose value through leaks, pressure overuse, poor sequencing and unloaded operation.
operational_basis: Plants often use compressed air as a convenience utility, allowing maintenance and operations drift to hide recurring losses.
financial_mechanism: Support-utility waste can inflate energy and maintenance cost while masquerading as structural process intensity.
typical_false_assumption: High plant energy intensity proves generic process inefficiency.
hypothesis: Compressed-air leakage, pressure overuse or weak sequencing may be materially affecting cost and support-system economics.
rival_hypotheses: compressed air is well managed and economically secondary
process duty dominates the visible energy story
maintenance and leakage are not material
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: leak survey or operating evidence shows meaningful leakage or pressure overuse
compressed air is materially relevant to the site's support-utility stack
falsification_conditions: compressed air use is structurally process-critical and already optimized
allowed_claim_language: Compressed-air leakage or pressure overuse is a recurring industrial pattern that should be falsified locally.
financial_exposure_if_true: support-system waste may outrank generic production-efficiency framing
maintenance and sequencing action may outperform equipment CAPEX
financial_exposure_if_false: attention should shift to process-duty or thermal rivals
stop_conditions: compressed-air leak and sequencing materiality are bounded enough to rank the hypothesis
escalation_conditions: temporary study or leak survey requested only if bills and runtime context still leave the hypothesis ambiguous
claim_permissions_impact: block compressor CAPEX recommendation without discrimination
example_outputs: Compressed air is a recurring hidden-loss mode, but materiality must be tested before capital is aimed at it.
tests: manufacturing acceptance bundles should surface this when compressed air is plausible and leakage evidence is absent
pattern must remain bounded at L2 until site evidence exists
